notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.17
notes.notes: [p][b]Features[/b][/p][p]New music tracks[/p][p]Overhauled combat GUI[/p][p]Upgraded FSR to 3.1.5[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Orb of Annihilation didn't always deal damage upon detonation[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tweaks/Balance[/b][/p][p]Revised player hit SFX[/p][p]Orb of Annihilation increased detonation radius and damage[/p][p]Minigun augmentation "Harnessed Destruction" - improved bounce trajectory calculations[/p][p]Saw Blade targeting updates:[/p][p]    If the blade collides with a structure before hitting an enemy, it will search that collision point for enemy targets[/p][p]    If no targets are found, the blade will begin returning to the player[/p][p]    If the blade collides with an enemy while returning to the player, it will acquire targets at the point of collision[/p][p]Improved enemy flight obstacle avoidance[/p][p]Improved enemy traversal jumping motions[/p]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.16
notes.notes:
[p][b]Features[/b][/p][p]Enemies now get staggered and interrupted upon receiving damage[/p][p]	Staggers are triggered when enemy health falls below certain health thresholds[/p][p]	Damage source influences the duration of the stagger[/p][p]Added a setting to adjust overall blood visual levels[/p][p]Added camera shake to certain events
[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Rifle wouldn't play reload animation in certain scenarios[/p][p]Launcher wasn't reloading on shoot as expected in certain scenarios
[/p][p][b]Tweaks/Balance[/b][/p][p]Added weapon sway relative to camera motion[/p][p]Improved gun positional rotation relative to recoil when shooting[/p][p]Further improvements to blood VFX[/p][p]Improved enemy jump animations[/p][p]Visual layout improvements to PC control bindings page[/p][p]Added scale in to enemy orb projectile type attacks[/p][p]Added more prominent casting SFX to powerful enemy spells[/p][p]Further improvements to various other VFX[/p]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.15
notes.notes:
[p][b]Features[/b][/p][p]Enemies now emit light when engaged in combat
[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Enemies could spawn in a locked state in certain scenarios[/p][p]Player could jump higher than intended when partially on ledges[/p][p]The same button used to un-pause the game could have it's corresponding action performed[/p][p]Flyer enemies weren't granting Nanite on kill[/p][p]Fragmented corpses weren't  having forces applied properly[/p][p]Damageable non-enemy types no longer spawn hit VFX[/p][p]Launcher barrel wasn't always returning to the correct position upon reloading[/p][p]Launcher Barrage augmentation fixes:[/p][p]    Improved firing of single shots[/p][p]    You can no longer reload while pre-loading shots[/p][p]    You can no longer pre-load primary and secondary fire simultaneously
[/p][p][b]Tweaks/Balance[/b][/p][p]Increased Minigun primary fire damage and critical hit multiplier[/p][p]Additional visual improvements for the world[/p][p]Enemy Shield Barrier's visually reflect damage taken[/p][p]Various improvements to several VFX[/p][p]SSAO GFX setting is now off by default[/p][p]Updated the tutorial menu to better explain the Nanite mechanic[/p]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.14
notes.notes:
[p][b]Features[/b][/p][p]Added Gamepad aim assist and toggle setting[/p][p]Added Screen Space Ambient Occlusion GFX setting[/p][p]All GFX settings changes should no longer require a restart to take effect[/p][p]Improved visual feedback on successful shots with hitscan and bullet based damage[/p][p]Certain enemies can now traverse up and down ledges[/p][p]Added Warp Gate VFX on use[/p][p]Added VFX to enemies hit by EMP[/p][p]The current game version is displayed in the pause menu and end of game screen[/p][p]Added new keyboard control binds:[/p][p]Toggle UI (Keypad - )[/p][p]† Take Screenshot (Keypad + ) [/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Look sensitivity setting wasn't being applied to camera movement[/p][p]Fixed Malignant Sonar not revealing enemies[/p][p]Crows would fly in an unexpected manner after the game was un-paused[/p][p]Critters could experience navigation issues[/p][p]Improved monster pre-spawning and pooling[/p][p]You can no longer pause during death or the end game screen[/p][p]Added extra measures to keep flyer type enemies within the game bounds[/p][p]Ammo casings discharged after firing weren't behaving properly over time[/p][p]Sequential texts and timers will now pause/un-pause with the game[/p][p]Switching to gamepad input will set a menu selection if there isn't one[/p][p]Switching between input devices will properly update cursor state[/p][p]Many SFX will now pause and un-pause with the game
[/p][p][b]Tweaks/Balance[/b][/p][p]Improved world lighting[/p][p]Increased the pickup range on Shrine Orb pickups[/p][p]Added a slight delay to Static Charge detonations[/p][p]Reduced Shotgun primary fire shrapnel spread[/p][p]Improved several enemy's animation transitions[/p][p]Further GUI improvements
[/p][p]† Screenshots are saved to - C:\\Users<Username>\\AppData\\LocalLow\\HuxDev\\EXON\\Screenshots[/p]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.13
notes.notes:
[p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where some game state wouldn't reset properly on reloads[/p][p]Enemy Stalker could teleport outside the level bounds[/p][p]Anti Aliasing setting dropdown wasn't reflecting the actual value on load[/p][p]Enemies could play their melee attack SFX more often than intended[/p][p]Enemies and spawner VFX could orientate to unintended locations[/p][p]Projectile based weapon spread wasn't working as intended[/p][p]Some enemies could move during spell casting animations in certain scenarios[/p][p]Enemy Colossus spell Projectile Nova will now detonate when colliding with terrain or buildings[/p][p]Enemy ground targeted spells and abilities now properly calculate on non terrain positions[/p][p]Enemy Flyer's could get stuck outside the level bounds[/p][p]Enemy Heavy demon melee attack animations weren't transitioning properly[/p][p]Gun reload cost indicators wouldn't deactivate when switching guns in certain scenarios[/p][p]Spell Demon shield barrier could remain active if killed during casting animation[/p][p]Certain objects were allowing the player to jump before being grounded
[/p][p][b]Tweaks/Balance[/b][/p][p]Various improvements to the UI and menus[/p][p]Pistol -[/p][list][*][p]Slightly reduced firing rates[/p][/*][*][p]Increased base damage[/p][/*][*][p]Increased critical hit multipliers[/p][/*][/list][p]General Enemy AI -[/p][list][*][p]Flyer type enemies will only attack when facing the player[/p][/*][*][p]Repositioning movement will try to maintain line of sight with the player[/p][/*][*][p]Better overall transitions out of melee attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Improved repositioning behaviour for each difficulty setting[/p][/*][*][p]Improved target rotations between movement and attacks[/p][/*][/list][p]Increased the base nanite gained from enemy kills[/p][p]Increased Shotgun damage and projectile speeds[/p][p]Increased enemy Colossus spell cooldown times[/p][p]Reduced hit detection size for enemy Mutant spell Lightning Strike[/p][p]Increased the concurrent number of enemies that can be damaged by grenade type weapons[/p][p]Improved Launcher reload states to match animation timings[/p][p]Enemy Spell Demon spell Impale now has a fixed target distance and travel speed[/p][p]Added a music track[/p]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.12
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved restart game logic to prevent edge case bugs
[*] Psionic blast damage multiplier was dealing more damage than intended
[*] Rifle augmentation "Lightning Conduit" was dealing more damage than intended
[*] Launcher augmentation "Seeker Missiles" target wasn't always clearing on kill
[*] Further improvements to Blood splatter rendering issues
[/list]

[b]Tweaks/Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Siphoning Saw damage increased, now heals on each hit, move speed further increased on successful hit
[*] Launcher augmentation "Bombardier" changed to - reduces reload cost and reloads instantly
[*] Smoother crow flight motion
[*] Improved enemy Flyer movement patterns and obstacle avoidance
[*] Some player GUI elements will now hide while interact/world space menus are open
[*] Improved sync and timing of end of game screen components
[*] Increased projectile speed of Shotgun, Rifle and Minigun
[*] Pistol augmentation "Sentry Turret" base damage reduced (damage effects unchanged)
[*] Adjust portal SFX volume
[*] GFX settings menu now displays a message if a restart is required for new settings to take effect
[*] Reduced the damage of some high output enemies
[/list]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.9
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
- Weapon swap overhaul
[list]
[*] Decreased unequip times of all weapons
[*] Weapon swaps can be now be interrupted by performing another weapon swap
[*] Revised the timing of GUI elements to better represent when a weapon has completed equipping
[*] Next and previous weapon can now be selected via Mouse Wheel or controller D-Pad Left or Right
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Launcher grenades weren't always colliding with others objects
- Launcher projectile outlines weren't always showing
- Difficulty would default to easy if no difficulty buttons were pressed
- Minigun wasn't reloading when pressing shoot after gaining enough nanite to reload
- Minigun now triggers the proper reload animation sequence when continuing to hold fire

[b]Tweaks[/b]
- Improved gunshot recoil animations
- Nanite tutorial text improved for clarity
- You can now reload and use abilities for free between rounds
- Adjusted the position of text tips
- Improved player pickups world GUI position and orientation
- Added tweening for all tutorial pages content
- Added visual markers for nanite orbs generated from kills
- Added gamepad camera look dead zones
- Weapon wheel enhancements
[list]
[*] Inner GUI is now an arrow indicating the current input direction angle
[*] Improved weapon selection zone calculations
[*] Increased the selection dead zone when using a mouse
[*] Added a camera lock delay when switching weapon via weapon wheel on gamepads
[/list]
- Added copied confirmation text for copy to Discord button
- Launcher augmentation "Seeker Missiles" now has a sticky duration for locked targets
- Improved Rifle secondary fire sniper shot cooldown visuals
- Death sequence now auto reloads the level

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.7
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The last few enemies of each round get markers placed on them
[*] Health and Nanite bars will flash when either resource is gained
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Seeker missiles could retain previous targeting info
[*] Improved collision detection for Rifle and Minigun primary fire and both Launcher projectiles
[*] Fixed additional object pool issues
[*] Tips now fit properly on Steam Deck screen
[*] Spell Demon ability Impale now only deals 1 instance of damage per cast
[*] Flyer dissolve effect on death fix
[*] Fragmented corpses weren't always behaving as expected

[/list]

[b]Tweaks/Balance[/b]
[list]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.6
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Controls button in pause menu to open controls menu directly
[*] Added text tips between rounds with toggle setting
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Certain enemy spells weren't always dealing damage
[*] Errors in player pickups text descriptions
[*] Pistol could reload during alternate fire sequence
[*] Music wasn't looping, or stopping on death
[*] All enemy damage output, including spells, are now affected by damage reduction debuffs
[*] Spell Demon ability Impale now correctly targets a location beyond the player
[*] Particles weren't always returning to the pool, causing memory leaks
[*] Enemies weren't behaving in the expected manner on easy and medium difficulties
[/list]

[b]Tweaks/Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced maximum concurrent monsters count
[*] Rebalanced rounds - slower introduction of enemy types and more gradual difficulty curve
[*] Siphoning Blade augmentation "Augmented Reconstruction" removed
[*] New Siphoning Blade augmentation "Rebalanced Blade" - Siphoning Blade can hit 2 additional enemies
[*] New Psionic Blast augmentation "Psionic Evisceration" - Hitting 3 or more targets greatly increases blast damage
[*] Psionic Blast base damage increased
[*] Rifle augmentation "Penetrating Rounds" removed
[*] Penetrating Rounds is now included in the Rifle baseline
[*] New Rifle augmentation "Static Charge" - Rifle secondary kills create a damaging electric pulse. Kills from these pulses trigger additional pulses.
[*] Minigun secondary fire Orb of Annihilation can no longer bounce off objects
[*] Minigun augmentation "Magnetic Annihilation" removed
[*] New Minigun augmentation "Harnessed Destruction" - Orb of Annihilation can bounce off obstacles and duration is extended
[*] New Minigun augmentation "Juggernaut" - Kills with primary fire grant shield
[*] New Minigun augmentation "Hyperspin Module" - Reduces barrel wind up time and increases firing rate
[*] Spell Demon ability Magic Missiles no longer locks onto the player
[*] Player pickups world GUI nanite cost text color matches other text
[*] Player pickups world GUI ability nanite cost has scrolling texture and reflects the actual cost
[*] Player pickups world GUI ability/gun backing circle more prominent
[/list]

notes.title: EXON Demo Patch 0.7.5
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Add smoothening/dampening to camera look when using a gamepad
[*] Add slider setting for maximum standard corpse count
[*] Add tutorial menu demo videos for orb mechanics
[*] Show nanite cost for abilities at bottom of GUI card
[*] Flyer enemies dissolve effect on death if not fragmented
[*] Add hit VFX for several projectile attacks
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Anti Aliasing settings not saving/loading
[*] Crimson Combustion can't damage enemy shields
[*] Enemy Colossus movement not locked when casting certain spells
[*] Augmentation Regenerating Artillery can fire below 0 ammo
[*] Siphoning Blade can hit more enemies than the intended amount
[*] Shotgun augmentation Eternal shredder doesn't always proc
[*] Shotgun augmentation Eternal Shredder procs while reloading could result in reloading past the max ammo count

[/list]

[b]Tweaks/Balance[/b]

[*] Crosshairs changed to opaque teal

[*] Improved all gunshot SFX

[*] Settings now specifies AMD FSR 3.1
[*] Colossus will cast Meteor in more scenarios
[*] Minigun secondary Orb of Annihilation moves faster, has shorter acquisition range and reduced duration

[*] Siphoning Blade heals for a greater amount for each target hit
[*] Enemy barrier damage particles replaced
[/list]

[b]Optimisations[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced memory usage
[*] Reduced run time memory allocations/garbage collection
[*] Reduced render calls
[/list]
